[[File:Ammo mould detail.png|left|130x200px]]
An '''ammo mould''' is a [[quest items|quest item]] used in [[Dwarf Cannon]]. It is obtained from [[Nulodion]] after speaking to [[Captain Lawgof]] after repairing his broken [[dwarf multicannon]]. Additional moulds can be purchased from Nulodion's [[Multicannon parts for sale]] store for {{NoCoins|5|c}}. 

It is given to Captain Lawgof alongside [[Nulodion's notes]] to complete the quest. It is also used to smith [[cannonballs]] with [[Bar|metal bars]] at a [[furnace]] to make 4 cannonballs per bar.

The [[double ammo mould]] is the upgraded version of this mould obtainable from [[Giants' Foundry]], capable of producing up to 8 cannonballs at once, using two bars at once.

With 87 [[Sailing]], the [[Ancient Furnace]] can be accessed within the [[Grimstone Dungeon]] and used to smelt cannonballs at double speed.
